name: Palmsun Strike
description: Strike with a small sun held in each palm so the blow lands twice in one motion.

name: Sunpair Guard
description: Cross the two palm suns before the chest in the school's first guard.

name: Palmsun Mend
description: Rest one palm sun on a hurt of an ally or the self and let it heal as it warms.

name: Cross Palmsun
description: Cross both palm suns in a scissoring blow that burns on both sides of the target.

name: Palmsun Bloom
description: Open both palm suns outward in a bloom of heat that scorches the ground before the user.

name: Sunpair Purge
description: Draw taint out of an ally into one palm sun and burn it away in the other.

name: Palmsun Barrage
description: Spin both palm suns and cast them as a run of burning shots at one target.

name: Sunpair Restoration
description: Rest both palm suns on a gravely wounded ally and mend the flesh from both sides.

name: Palmsun Rend
description: Slam the two suns together on the target and rend guard and plate with the joined heat.

name: Sunpair Zenith
description: The school's finishing move in which both palm suns rise together to a joined zenith and fall with a force that grows with the user's reserve.

name: Dawnguard Stance
description: Take the school's low stance wrapped in the pale gold of first light so that blows meet a steady edge.

name: Azuresun Gleam
description: Read the wounded of the guarded ranks by the pale gleam each body gives back.

name: Guard Warmth
description: Pass the warmth of the guard to a hurt member of the ranks and ease the pain.

name: Dawnguard Turn
description: Turn aside a heavy blow on the edge of the guard and throw it wide.

name: Azure Rim
description: Hold a pale rim of light round the guarded ranks until the assault falls away.

name: Dawnguard Purge
description: Burn poison and taint from the guarded with a clean steady light.

name: Azure Rouse
description: Rouse the weary of the ranks with a swift pulse of pale warmth.

name: Dawnguard Canopy
description: Spread a wide canopy of first light over the whole guard to take a heavy volley.

name: Azure Revival
description: Pour the guard's gathered light into a member who has just fallen and call the breath back.

name: Gilded Absorption
description: Drink the force of a great blow into the gold of the guard and turn it into warmth for the ranks.

name: Azure Sunrise
description: The school's crowning move in which a pale sunrise lifts over the whole guard and closes wounds while it turns away harm.

name: Sunwell Draw
description: Draw sun qi down into the belly as water fills a well.

name: Rillgold Touch
description: Let a thin gold rill run from the well through the fingers into a hurt of an ally or the self.

name: Sunwell Reading
description: Feel how deep the well stands and how much of it is left to spend.

name: Sunwell Fist
description: Throw a fist carried on a short rush from the well.

name: Rillgold Mending
description: Run the rill along a long wound of an ally or the self from end to end.

name: Sunwell Ward
description: Spill the well's water-bright light into a ring that stops blows at the rim.

name: Rillgold Cleanse
description: Rinse the veins of a poisoned ally with the gold rill until the water runs clear.

name: Sunwell Torrent
description: Open a sluice of the well and pour a hard torrent of light on the target.

name: Wellspring Surge
description: Surge the wellspring through the limbs of every ally in reach.

name: Rillgold Flood
description: Break the rill's banks and spread a flood of gold light over the ground ahead.

name: Sunwell Collapse
description: Let the whole well fall in on a single point so the target is crushed by the weight of light.

name: Rillgold Overflow
description: The school's last act in which the full well overflows to burn the foe on one bank and heal the allies on the other.

name: Twintrack Ray
description: Cast one ray along each of the two tracks so they strike the same point from both sides.

name: Crownfire Guard
description: Raise a small crown of fire over the head that turns what falls from above.

name: Crown Warmth
description: Rest the crown's warmth on the head of an ally or the self and calm the hurt.

name: Twintrack Brand
description: Burn a mark along each track on the target so that it cannot slip either way.

name: Crownfire Lance
description: Drive a lance from the crown through guard and plate.

name: Crown Purge
description: Burn a curse out of an ally through the crown of the head.

name: Twintrack Rouse
description: Run the two tracks through an ally to quicken both mind and limb.

name: Crownfire Burst
description: Let the crown flare outward in a great circle of fire.

name: Twintrack Revival
description: Send both tracks into the chest of a freshly fallen ally and call the heart back to beat.

name: Solar Crownfall
description: Bring the whole crown down on one target in a single blow of sun fire.

name: Dual Crown Blaze
description: The school's highest move in which both tracks meet at the crown and the joined blaze fills the sky above and burns the ground below.

name: Oathdawn Palm
description: Strike with a palm sworn at daybreak so it lands with the weight of the vow.

name: Oathdawn Ward
description: Raise the oath as a ward of dawn light round a companion.

name: Oathdawn Mend
description: Keep the sworn warmth on a companion's wound until it knits.

name: Oathdawn Sense
description: Hold the oath in mind and feel where the companion stands and how they fare.

name: Oathdawn Lash
description: Cast a sworn cord of dawn light round an attacker and haul the attacker off the companion.

name: Oathdawn Purge
description: Burn a curse from a companion while the sworn light holds steady.

name: Oathdawn Vigil
description: Keep a sleepless healing watch over a companion through the whole night.

name: Oathdawn Burst
description: Burst out in sworn light to clear those pressing on a companion.

name: Oathdawn Revival
description: Spend the oath itself to call a lately fallen companion back from the edge.

name: Oathdawn Bulwark
description: Spread the sworn light over all in reach and hold it against the heaviest blows.

name: Oathdawn Reckoning
description: Judge the one who harmed a companion and strike with the full light of the oath.

name: Gale Daybreak Vow
description: The school's vow spoken at daybreak that lights every companion with sworn strength and guards them as long as the oath is kept.

name: Steadyray Jab
description: Jab along the line of a steady ray so the point of the blow does not stray.

name: Linesun Guard
description: Hold the ray before the body and slide each blow along it and off.

name: Steadyray Sense
description: Send the ray out to find the nearest solid shape along its line.

name: Linesun Dart
description: Fire a dart down the ray that lands where the ray points.

name: Steadyray Mend
description: Hold the ray on a wound of an ally or the self until it closes.

name: Linesun Lock
description: Pin the qi of an opponent along the ray so it cannot be gathered for a technique.

name: Steadyray Pierce
description: Drive the ray through every guard along its line in one thrust.

name: Linesun Renewal
description: Hold a ray steady on a badly hurt ally until the flesh sets.

name: Steadyray Verdict
description: Send one unwavering ray through the target and everything behind it.

name: Unbending Ray
description: The school's last stroke in which one ray leaves the user and holds its line however far the target runs.

name: Noonsworn Fist
description: Hit with a fist sworn to the noon that holds against any gust.

name: Noonsworn Guard
description: Stand against the wind with a bright guard that does not give.

name: Noonsworn Warmth
description: Share the noon's warmth with a battered ally standing in the gale.

name: Noonsworn Flare
description: Cast a flare against the wind so it burns straight through the rush of air.

name: Noonsworn Mantle
description: Wrap the user and an ally in a mantle of noon that blunts the gale.

name: Noonsworn Purge
description: Burn taint and blown poison out of an ally in the clear glare.

name: Noonsworn Rouse
description: Rouse an ally with a warm gust and a bright command.

name: Noonsworn Tempest
description: Whip the noon and the wind into one tempest of light over the field.

name: Noonsworn Revival
description: Stand over a fallen ally in the full noon and drive the light into the chest.

name: Noonsworn Judgement
description: Hurl the sworn noon against the gale so it tears a straight path through all in its way.

name: Galebreaking Sun
description: The school's greatest answer in which the sworn sun stands against the gale and answers it with a storm of light.

name: Deepsun Pulse
description: Send a pulse up from the sun's heart in the user that scorches the near ground.

name: Deepsun Ward
description: Hold the sworn heat before the body as a thick ward.

name: Deepsun Touch
description: Pass the heart's warmth into the hurt of an ally or the self.

name: Deepsun Sense
description: Listen for the beat of the sun in every living chest nearby.

name: Deepsun Eruption
description: Let the heart's heat erupt through the ground at the feet of the opponents.

name: Deepsun Mantle
description: Wear a thick mantle of the sun's own fire that nothing mortal passes.

name: Deepsun Purge
description: Burn the foulest taint from an ally with fire drawn from below.

name: Deepsun Rouse
description: Feed the ally's core with the heart's warmth until strength floods back.

name: Deepsun Revival
description: Draw the heart's fire up into the chest of a fallen ally and light the pulse again.

name: Deepsun Geyser
description: Raise a geyser of white fire from the ground beneath the foe.

name: Deepsun Rending
description: Break the ground and burn the opponent in the eruption of the heart's fire.

name: Sunheart Oath
description: The school's deepest oath spoken to the sun's own heart that rises as a pillar of light through the user and floods allies with strength.
